basic_info.description: Experience the Essence of Chic and Comfort!  The 60's style brings clean line, open floor plan and integration with surrounding landscape which you can embrace and enjoy in this delightfully charming, centrally located contemporary apartment.  This convenient second floor unit offers 2 bedrooms, 1 upgraded full bath, and efficient, practical and thoughtfully refurbish Galley style kitchen.  As you entering this flat, it opens to generously sized living/dining combo area that is effortlessly flows into south facing private deck.  The primary bedroom is generously proportioned and provides good storage space, additionally; there is 1 good size bedrooms that offer versatile living options.  This is by far, the most affordable and central place in the city settled in St. Francis Sq. cooperative community surrounded by trees and nestled in a park like setting.  This perfectly positioned in essential location property offers unparalleled access to the lively shops and renowned restaurants of Lower Pacific Height, including the vibrant Fillmore Street and Japantown.
